assignments_dates.name: assignments_dates
assignments_dates.value: "assignments"."due_at" IS NULL OR "assignments"."published_at" IS NULL OR "assignments"."published_at" <= "assignments"."due_at"

facility_business_exceptions_times.name: facility_business_exceptions_times
facility_business_exceptions_times.value: ("facility_business_exceptions"."opens_at" IS NULL AND "facility_business_exceptions"."closes_at" IS NULL) OR ("facility_business_exceptions"."opens_at" IS NOT NULL AND "facility_business_exceptions"."closes_at" IS NOT NULL AND "facility_business_exceptions"."opens_at" < "facility_business_exceptions"."closes_at")

resources_effective_dates.name: resources_effective_dates
resources_effective_dates.value: "resources"."effective_to" IS NULL OR "resources"."effective_from" IS NULL OR "resources"."effective_from" <= "resources"."effective_to"

resources_event_dates.name: resources_event_dates
resources_event_dates.value: "resources"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "resources"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "resources"."starts_at" <= "resources"."ends_at"

schedule_exceptions_times.name: schedule_exceptions_times
schedule_exceptions_times.value: ("schedule_exceptions"."starts_at" IS NULL AND "schedule_exceptions"."ends_at" IS NULL) OR ("schedule_exceptions"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "schedule_exceptions"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "schedule_exceptions"."starts_at" < "schedule_exceptions"."ends_at")

users_role_school.name: users_role_school
users_role_school.value: ("users"."role" = 'super_admin' AND "users"."school_id" IS NULL) OR ("users"."role" IN ('admin','general') AND "users"."school_id" IS NOT NULL)
